caption:
Most software trials want your card before you've logged in once.

Forget to cancel and they bill you for a tool you never used.

Black Arrow skips that part. 14 days, full platform, no card required.

Use the two weeks on purpose. Trigger the missed-call text-back. Send yourself a test lead and time the inbox alert. Book a test appointment and watch the reminder fire.

Refer one business while you're in there. When they subscribe, you both get a free month.

DM TRIAL
#ServiceBusiness #HomeServices #SmallBusinessGrowth #CRMSoftware #LeadGeneration
rationale: No-card risk reversal is a clean differentiator in a category where every competitor gates the trial behind a card. The self-test sequence gives the owner a concrete way to validate the system before committing, which builds trust faster than a feature list.
